slides.title: Trays in the workshop
slides.text: The workshops are open again, and the first job is packing. Rolls, seeds and tiles all travel in trays, and every tray holds the same number.

visual.label: Every tray holds the same number

focus.cue: One row is one tray, filled the same as every other.
Tray after tray, the count never changes.

slides.title: Equal groups multiply
slides.text: When groups are equal, adding again and again is slow. Multiplication is the shortcut: count the groups, count what is in each group, and multiply.

visual.label: 4 trays of 5 rolls drawn as an array: 4 rows of 5

focus.cue: One row is one tray: 5 rolls.
4 trays of 5 is 20 rolls in all.

slides.title: Rough first, then group
slides.text: Rough first: 6 trays of 7 rolls is a bit under 50. Count the rolls tray by tray, then take the shortcut.

visual.label: 6 trays of 7 rolls drawn as an array: 6 rows of 7 is 42

focus.cue: Each row is a tray of 7. Skip-count: 7, 14, 21...
Six rows of 7: 6 x 7 = 42 rolls in all.

slides.title: Arrays are groups drawn
slides.text: Draw the groups as rows and the picture does the counting. Six rows of seven is the same total turned either way: 7 rows of six works too.

visual.label: Six rows of seven: the same total turned either way

focus.cue: Each row holds 7. Skip-count the rows: 7, 14, 21...
Six rows of seven is 42, and seven rows of six is 42 too.

slides.title: Stretch: Bigger groups
slides.text: The shortcut scales up. For 23 x 4, split 23 into 20 and 3. Then 20 x 4 = 80 and 3 x 4 = 12, so 23 x 4 = 92.

rows.label: 23 x 4, split into two easy parts

words.means: joining equal groups into one total, the fast way
a set of things counted together
things set out in equal rows and columns
one of the numbers you multiply together

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Sum Racer. It opens on the 2, 5 and 10 times tables track, and it stays there. Win the race: picture the trays of groups before you answer each fact.
